title: Christmas-Lights Power and Cost
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=festive:lights
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(kwh) as kwh by _time
| eval cost=round(kwh*0.30,2)
| sort - _time
description: Adds up the electricity your festive lights use each day and what it costs, settling the annual debate.
value: Putting a real daily cost on the Christmas display turns the yearly grumble into a fun, factual number.
implementation: Meter the lights on a smart plug into `index=personal`; total daily energy and cost.
visualization: Column chart of daily festive-light energy and cost.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up what your Christmas lights cost to run each day, settling the yearly family debate.
